why: These are the gf sources AGSS21 itself names for CNO, not a generic NIST pull. RYA-946 precedence is lab > NIST-C+ > Kurucz > VALD.

sources.citation: Li, Amarsi, Papoulia, Ekman & Jonsson 2021, MNRAS 502, 3780

sources.method: MCDHF/RCI -- THEORY, not laboratory. Never tier LAB.
sources.coverage: C I, C II, C III, C IV (tables A2-A5)

sources.agss21_role: N i gf -- AGSS21: 'taken from Tachiev & Froese Fischer (2002) and are expected to be reliable at the 0.03 dex level based on rankings from NIST'
sources.method: Breit-Pauli MCHF -- THEORY, not laboratory. Never tier LAB.

sources.BLOCKER: Aki + uncertainty + level identity only. The CDS holding ships NO level energies, so no wavelength and no gf. A->gf requires a level join. These rows are NOT gf and must not be graded yet.
